name: breathesafe-campus
description: BreatheSafe Campus - Air Quality Action Engine

scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build:aqi && npm run build:recommendation && npm run build:alerts
scripts.install:all: npm run install:shared && npm run install:aqi && npm run install:recommendation && npm run install:alerts
scripts.deploy: cd infrastructure && sam build && sam deploy
scripts.deploy:guided: cd infrastructure && sam build && sam deploy --guided
